head: 3e0d3cee06ff827acbd85c961cf222833a839551
implementation: Retryable factory issue rows offer a Retry action. Positive safe integer issue identity is carried as explicit factory-retry private action, not a prompt or arbitrary command string.
App.perform invokes existing /retry command path; actual current stack lookup, retryable check, signed-in repository scope, POST item route and refusal behavior retained.
Request is persisted before authentication/lookup; existing duplicate suppression and conversation-owner result storage preserved. Ordinary prompt actions remain literal model text.

originalRed.reason: existing factory row has no action and Action schema rejects new factory-retry variant

actualTerminal.boundary: actual production src/main.tsx in isolated tmux PTY with real localHTTP CloudSession transport; controlled API state and scripted model replay

owningFormat.command: dprint check src/panels.ts src/factory.ts src/app.tsx test/factory.test.ts test/extension.test.ts test/key-dispatch.test.ts e2e/factory-retry.test.ts README.md

acceptance: Retry actions present for blocked/rejected/declined/reviewHeld proposed issues; absent on queued/running/retrying/landed/ordinaryproposed/noissue/group rows.
Actual row selection and action key persist requested before unresolved lookup, then POST; publication/display alone sends no POST or model call.
Actual duplicate row action and repeated command send only one lookup/POST while pending; Chat replies during unresolved lookup and POST.
Actual authenticated exact encoded item retry receives returned state and factory readback. Invalid/nonretryable/unknown issues never POST.
Actual403 permission refusal remains visible; full typed HTTP diagnostic retained in log, sensitive route/status not added to visible product copy; retry after refusal works.
Late response writes only original conversation journal after /new; resumed original conversation restores requested and actual result.
Explicit action schema rejects zero/negative/fractional/unsafe/non-number identities; ordinary slash-shaped panel prompt still sends literal model text.

apiDisposition.semanticDisposition: Panels.Action union is an internal private TUI serializable contract. Existing variants retain their fields and literal prompt behavior. Added factory-retry is selected by the person and uses current signed-in repository retry route. CLI declaration compiler graph contains no apps/tui source; no owning public declaration changes or API baseline regeneration required. CLI shipped TUI bundle behavior changes, but no fresh bundle/pack/release qualification claimed.

limits: Focused unit and actual terminal integration independently meaningful; no whole-TUI suite/100%coverage, compiled installed binary, fresh npm pack or release claim. Configured coverage policies unchanged.

API responses and model recording controlled locally to avoid outbound Cloud/provider actions; terminal, native local host, real HTTP, signed-in CloudSession transport and persisted session storage execute. Synthetic token only.
Existing API/refusal status semantics untouched; foreign issue3247 excluded.
First candidate types exposed boolean return and widened test literal; both corrected with final full TUI type gate green; failed receipt retained.
